eval.description: OpenAI internal Capture-the-Flag suite used in Preparedness cyber evaluations. Curated competition-style challenges (high school, collegiate, and professional difficulty) run in a headless Linux box with offensive tools. Scored mainly as pass@12 over multiple rollouts; later cards often focus on the professional set and an internal CTF label.
eval.summary: Measures whether AI agents can solve cybersecurity challenges that need hacking skills, from easy to expert level.

links.title: OpenAI o3 system card — Capture the Flag

versions.changes: OpenAI updates a small share of challenges over time for harness bugs; later cards emphasize professional CTFs and an Internal CTF label.

scores.description: The agent recovers the challenge flag within the allowed tool-use budget on that rollout.

metrics.description: pass@12 over rollouts per challenge, often averaged within High School / Collegiate / Professional (or Internal) slices.
